audit_items.proof_trace: The borrow/withdraw limiter is stored per (emode_group, asset) in EModeGroup.assets[CoinType].EModeRateLimiter; all obligations sharing the same emode_group call add_outflow on the same single limiter instance (via borrow_mut_emode(registry, obligation.emode_group(), asset_name)). Since obligation.emode_group is immutable after creation and the limiter object is a shared on-chain table entry, splitting borrows across any number of obligations within the same emode group accumulates into the same counter and cannot bypass the limit. Obligations in different emode groups have independently configured limits by intentional design.
